comment: Frozen `ecbench exec` child inputs whose solve instruction count (callgrind Ir between the ecbench_before_solve/ecbench_solve markers) is tracked over time by scripts/perf/perfhistory.py as kernels of the `ecbench` area. Each is one execution of research/ecbench_calibration_20261002 (ecbench profile-input --spec … --seq …); expected_recovered is the planted logarithm the child must return, and the counted phases must not change, or the row is marked re-based. Add a child by appending an entry; never edit an existing one (change the id instead).
